result.detail:
Design choices:
- rst_n is left free. The interface spec states no power-up value, so I do not assume reset in the first cycle. Only CC-RANGE depends on having seen a reset, and it is guarded by f_rst_done. The other one-step properties hold from any state, so they are checked unguarded.
- MAX=255 is not instantiated. Its empty-state and underflow covers need more than 255 cycles, beyond depth 20. CC-PARAM is therefore covered only at MAX=1, 4 (the default) and 5 (not a power of two); full range coverage would need a separate deeper setup.
- The rule that err does not rise without a refusal is read from the port description of err ('High once a take or a give has been refused').
- CC-STATUS (avail and full) is asserted combinationally, with no guard.
- My files sit at the top level beside credit_counter.v, and I wrote no file with that name.

Review and runs:
- Upstream reviews are [evidence:prj-4986bc98bc.interface-spec.e1] and [evidence:prj-4986bc98bc.design-under-test.e1]. This work still needs its own independent review.
- If formal.cover reports an unreached derived cover, the first suspect is the multi-instance top. The fallback is a single instance at MAX=5.
